import math

# The correct Hill estimator formula is:
# alpha = k / sum_{i=1}^{k} log(X_i / X_{k+1})
# where X_1 >= X_2 >= ... >= X_n are sorted descending, and X_{k+1} is the (k+1)th largest

# Sorted values in descending order
sorted_values = [735828, 536530, 417974, 350082, 271859, 257446, 235458, 222639, 209293, 190438]

k = 7
X_kplus1 = sorted_values[k]  # 8th largest value = 222639

print(f"k = {k}")
print(f"X_kplus1 (8th largest) = {X_kplus1}")
print()

# Compute log ratios
log_ratios = []
for i in range(k):
    ratio = sorted_values[i] / X_kplus1
    log_ratio = math.log(ratio)
    log_ratios.append(log_ratio)
    print(f"log({sorted_values[i]} / {X_kplus1}) = log({ratio:.4f}) = {log_ratio:.6f}")

print()
print(f"Sum of log ratios: {sum(log_ratios):.6f}")
alpha = k / sum(log_ratios)
print(f"alpha = {k} / {sum(log_ratios):.6f} = {alpha:.6f}")
print()
print(f"Pareto tail exponent (alpha): {alpha:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(alpha, 3)}")
